title: Scenario-driven optimization of passive vehicle suspensions: explaining the effectiveness of asymmetric damping
summary: Asymmetric damping is widely used in passive vehicle suspensions, with rebound damping often recommended to exceed compression damping by a factor of two to three. Despite its prevalence, this guideline remains largely empirical and lacks a systematic derivation based on vehicle dynamics and excitation conditions. This paper presents a scenario-driven optimization framework that provides a principled explanation for the effectiveness of asymmetric damping.
